READ
What is given? Read every clue.
MARK

Watch out!
One small word changes the whole answer.
QuestionWatch forExample
Q 1Y must still be a 6-digit number.So X + 2,00,000 cannot reach 10 lakh.
Q 2All the numbers on the dial-pad.Do not forget the 0.
Q 3Exactly two digits are common.Y has only one even digit.
Q 6Only numbers between 2 lakhs and 8 lakhs.Count the others out.
Q 9The question asks about Calvin.Find both his job and his salary.

Try one first, with Dyna
How many zeros are there in ten crore?
a) 7
b) 8
c) 9
d) 10
Before you open a hint, write your plan in one line:
Hint 1 · Vault
What do I already know? One crore is 1,00,00,000.
Hint 2 · Echo
Say it in your own words: "Ten crore is ten times one crore."
Hint 3 · Translator
Write one crore in digits, then write ten times that number.
YOUR TURN
Count the zeros in the number you wrote.
Use the hints one at a time. Try on your own before you read the next one.
Before you start
There is no activity in this chapter. Keep a pencil ready to write numbers in a place-value chart.
Challenge ahead
The Thinking Spot is a column puzzle: each number appears as many times as its value.
